`no_empty_export: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)Don’t create `export {}`.
By default, strip creates `export {}` for modules to preserve module
context.

https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/1698

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.import_export_assign_config)

`ts_enum_is_mutable: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)Disables an optimization that inlines TS enum member values within the same module that assumes the enum member values are never modified.

Defaults to false.

#[non_exhaustive]pub enum ImportsNotUsedAsValues {
    Remove,
    Preserve,
}
```
## Variants (Non-exhaustive)[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#variants)

## This enum is marked as non-exhaustive

Non-exhaustive enums could have additional variants added in future. Therefore, when matching against variants of non-exhaustive enums, an extra wildcard arm must be added to account for any future variants.

# TsImportExportAssignConfig in swc_ecma_transforms_typescript::typescript - Rust

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/swc_ecma_transforms_typescript/typescript/enum.TsImportExportAssignConfig.html

```
pub enum TsImportExportAssignConfig {
    Classic,
    Preserve,
    NodeNext,
    EsNext,
}
```
## Variants[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#variants)

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#variant.Classic)

### Classic

- Rewrite `import foo = require("foo")`to`var foo = require("foo")`
- Rewrite `export =`to`module.exports =`

Note: This option is deprecated as all CJS/AMD/UMD can handle it themselves.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#variant.Preserve)

### Preserve

preserve for CJS/AMD/UMD

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#variant.NodeNext)

### NodeNext

Rewrite `import foo = require("foo")` to

```
import { createRequire as _createRequire } from "module";
const __require = _createRequire(import.meta.url);
const foo = __require("foo");
```
Report error for `export =`

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#variant.EsNext)

### EsNext

Both `import =` and `export =` are disabled.
An error will be reported if an import/export assignment is found.

[87](#87)    fn get_last_module_span(&self, n: &Module) -> Option<Span> {
[88](#88)        if self.config.no_empty_export {
[89](#89)            return None;
[90](#90)        }

[93](#93)            .iter()
[94](#94)            .rev()

[99](#99)    fn restore_esm_ctx(n: &mut Module, span: Span) {
[100](#100)        if n.body.iter().any(ModuleItem::is_es_module_decl) {
[101](#101)            return;
[102](#102)        }
[103](#103)

[105](#105)            NamedExport {
[106](#106)                span,
[107](#107)                ..NamedExport::dummy()
[108](#108)            }
[109](#109)            .into(),
[110](#110)        );
[111](#111)    }

[119](#119)    fn is_es_module_decl(&self) -> bool {
[120](#120)        match self {
[123](#123)            ModuleDecl::Import(..)
[124](#124)            | ModuleDecl::ExportDecl(..)
[125](#125)            | ModuleDecl::ExportNamed(..)
[126](#126)            | ModuleDecl::ExportDefaultDecl(..)
[127](#127)            | ModuleDecl::ExportDefaultExpr(..)
[128](#128)            | ModuleDecl::ExportAll(..) => true,
[129](#129)
[130](#130)            ModuleDecl::TsImportEquals(..)
[131](#131)            | ModuleDecl::TsExportAssignment(..)
[132](#132)            | ModuleDecl::TsNamespaceExport(..) => false,
[133](#133)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[134](#134)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[135](#135)        }
[136](#136)    }

[168](#168)fn id_for_jsx(e: &Expr) -> Option<Id> {
[172](#172)    match e {
[173](#173)        Expr::Ident(i) => Some(i.to_id()),
[174](#174)        Expr::Member(MemberExpr { obj, .. }) => Some(id_for_jsx(obj)).flatten(),
[175](#175)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(..)) => Some((atom!("null"), Default::default())),
[176](#176)        _ => None,
[177](#177)    }
[178](#178)}

[197](#197)    fn visit_mut_module(&mut self, n: &mut Module) {
[198](#198)        if !self.config.verbatim_module_syntax {
[203](#203)            let pragma = parse_expr_for_jsx(
[204](#204)                &self.cm,
[205](#205)                "pragma",
[206](#206)                self.tsx_config
[207](#207)                    .pragma
[208](#208)                    .clone()
[209](#209)                    .unwrap_or_else(|| static_str!("React.createElement")),
[210](#210)                self.top_level_mark,
[211](#211)            );
[212](#212)
[213](#213)            let pragma_frag = parse_expr_for_jsx(
[214](#214)                &self.cm,
[215](#215)                "pragma",
[216](#216)                self.tsx_config
[217](#217)                    .pragma_frag
[218](#218)                    .clone()
[219](#219)                    .unwrap_or_else(|| static_str!("React.Fragment")),
[220](#220)                self.top_level_mark,
[221](#221)            );
[222](#222)
[223](#223)            let pragma_id = id_for_jsx(&pragma).unwrap();
[224](#224)            let pragma_frag_id = id_for_jsx(&pragma_frag).unwrap();
[225](#225)
[226](#226)            self.id_usage.insert(pragma_id);
[227](#227)            self.id_usage.insert(pragma_frag_id);
[228](#228)        }
[229](#229)
[230](#230)        if !self.config.verbatim_module_syntax {
[231](#231)            let span = if n.shebang.is_some() {
[232](#232)                n.span
[233](#233)                    .with_lo(n.body.first().map(|s| s.span_lo()).unwrap_or(n.span.lo))
[234](#234)            } else {
[235](#235)                n.span
[236](#236)            };
[237](#237)
[238](#238)            let JsxDirectives {
[239](#239)                pragma,
[240](#240)                pragma_frag,
[241](#241)                ..
[242](#242)            } = self.comments.with_leading(span.lo, |comments| {
[243](#243)                JsxDirectives::from_comments(&self.cm, span, comments, self.top_level_mark)
[244](#244)            });
[245](#245)
[246](#246)            if let Some(pragma) = pragma {
[247](#247)                if let Some(pragma_id) = id_for_jsx(&pragma) {
[248](#248)                    self.id_usage.insert(pragma_id);
[249](#249)                }
[250](#250)            }
[251](#251)
[252](#252)            if let Some(pragma_frag) = pragma_frag {
[253](#253)                if let Some(pragma_frag_id) = id_for_jsx(&pragma_frag) {
[254](#254)                    self.id_usage.insert(pragma_frag_id);
[255](#255)                }
[256](#256)            }
[257](#257)        }
[258](#258)    }
[259](#259)
[260](#260)    fn visit_mut_script(&mut self, _: &mut Script) {
[261](#261)        }
[263](#263)
[264](#264)    fn visit_mut_program(&mut self, n: &mut Program) {
[265](#265)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[266](#266)

[270](#270)            top_level_mark: self.top_level_mark,
[271](#271)            id_usage: mem::take(&mut self.id_usage),
[272](#272)        });
[273](#273)    }

[57](#57)    fn visit_mut_class_members(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ClassMember>) {
[58](#58)        n.retain(|member| match member {
[59](#59)            ClassMember::TsIndexSignature(..) => false,
[60](#60)            ClassMember::Constructor(Constructor { body: None, .. }) => false,
[61](#61)
[62](#62)            ClassMember::Method(ClassMethod {
[63](#63)                is_abstract,
[64](#64)                function,
[65](#65)                ..
[66](#66)            })
[67](#67)            | ClassMember::PrivateMethod(PrivateMethod {
[68](#68)                is_abstract,
[69](#69)                function,
[70](#70)                ..
[71](#71)            }) => !is_abstract && function.body.is_some(),
[72](#72)
[73](#73)            ClassMember::ClassProp(
[74](#74)                ClassProp { declare: true, .. }
[75](#75)                | ClassProp {
[76](#76)                    is_abstract: true, ..
[77](#77)                },
[78](#78)            )
[79](#79)            | ClassMember::AutoAccessor(AutoAccessor {
[80](#80)                is_abstract: true, ..
[81](#81)            }) => false,
[82](#82)
[83](#83)            _ => true,
[84](#84)        });
[85](#85)
[86](#86)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[87](#87)    }

[91](#91)        n.is_override = false;
[92](#92)        n.is_abstract = false;
[93](#93)        n.is_optional = false;

[102](#102)        prop.is_abstract = false;

[121](#121)    fn visit_mut_export_specifiers(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ExportSpecifier>) {
[122](#122)        n.retain(|s| match s {
[123](#123)            ExportSpecifier::Named(ExportNamedSpecifier { is_type_only, .. }) => !is_type_only,
[124](#124)            _ => true,
[125](#125)        })
[126](#126)    }
[127](#127)
[128](#128)    fn visit_mut_expr(&mut self, n: &mut Expr) {
[129](#129)        while let Expr::TsAs(TsAsExpr { expr, .. })
[132](#132)        | Expr::TsNonNull(TsNonNullExpr { expr, .. })
[133](#133)        | Expr::TsTypeAssertion(TsTypeAssertion { expr, .. })
[134](#134)        | Expr::TsConstAssertion(TsConstAssertion { expr, .. })
[135](#135)        | Expr::TsInstantiation(TsInstantiation { expr, .. })
[136](#136)        | Expr::TsSatisfies(TsSatisfiesExpr { expr, .. }) = n
[137](#137)        {
[138](#138)            *n = *expr.take();
[139](#139)        }
[140](#140)
[141](#141)        maybe_grow_default(|| n.visit_mut_children_with(self));
[142](#142)    }
[143](#143)
[144](#144)    fn visit_mut_ident(&mut self, n: &mut Ident) {
[146](#146)        n.optional = false;
[147](#147)    }
[148](#148)
[149](#149)    fn visit_mut_import_specifiers(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ImportSpecifier>) {
[150](#150)        n.retain(|s| !matches!(s, ImportSpecifier::Named(named) if named.is_type_only));
[151](#151)    }
[152](#152)
[153](#153)    fn visit_mut_ts_module_block(&mut self, node: &mut TsModuleBlock) {
[154](#154)        let in_namespace = mem::replace(&mut self.in_namespace, true);
[155](#155)        node.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[156](#156)        self.in_namespace = in_namespace;
[157](#157)    }
[158](#158)
[159](#159)    fn visit_mut_module_items(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<ModuleItem>) {
[160](#160)        n.retain(|item| should_retain_module_item(item, self.in_namespace));
[161](#161)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[162](#162)    }
[163](#163)
[164](#164)    fn visit_mut_object_pat(&mut self, pat: &mut ObjectPat) {
[165](#165)        pat.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[166](#166)        pat.optional = false;
[167](#167)    }
[168](#168)
[169](#169)    fn visit_mut_params(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Param>) {
[171](#171)        if n.first()
[172](#172)            .filter(|param| {
[173](#173)                matches!(
[174](#174)                    ¶m.pat,
[175](#175)                    Pat::Ident(BindingIdent {
[176](#176)                        id: Ident { sym, .. },
[177](#177)                        ..
[178](#178)                    }) if &**sym == "this"
[179](#179)                )
[180](#180)            })
[181](#181)            .is_some()
[182](#182)        {
[183](#183)            n.drain(0..1);
[184](#184)        }
[185](#185)
[186](#186)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[187](#187)    }
[188](#188)
[189](#189)    fn visit_mut_private_prop(&mut self, prop: &mut PrivateProp) {
[190](#190)        prop.readonly = false;
[191](#191)        prop.is_override = false;
[192](#192)        prop.is_optional = false;
[193](#193)        prop.definite = false;
[194](#194)        prop.accessibility = None;
[195](#195)        prop.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[196](#196)    }
[197](#197)
[198](#198)    fn visit_mut_setter_prop(&mut self, n: &mut SetterProp) {
[199](#199)        n.this_param = None;
[200](#200)
[201](#201)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[202](#202)    }
[203](#203)
[204](#204)    fn visit_mut_simple_assign_target(&mut self, n: &mut SimpleAssignTarget) {
[205](#205)        while let SimpleAssignTarget::TsAs(TsAsExpr { expr, .. })
[208](#208)        | SimpleAssignTarget::TsNonNull(TsNonNullExpr { expr, .. })
[209](#209)        | SimpleAssignTarget::TsTypeAssertion(TsTypeAssertion { expr, .. })
[210](#210)        | SimpleAssignTarget::TsInstantiation(TsInstantiation { expr, .. })
[211](#211)        | SimpleAssignTarget::TsSatisfies(TsSatisfiesExpr { expr, .. }) = n
[212](#212)        {
[213](#213)            *n = expr.take().try_into().unwrap();
[214](#214)        }
[215](#215)
[216](#216)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[217](#217)    }
[218](#218)
[219](#219)    fn visit_mut_stmts(&mut self, n: &mut Vec<Stmt>) {
[220](#220)        n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[221](#221)        n.retain(|s| !matches!(s, Stmt::Empty(e) if e.span.is_dummy()));
[222](#222)    }
[223](#223)
[224](#224)    fn visit_mut_stmt(&mut self, n: &mut Stmt) {
[225](#225)        if should_retain_stmt(n) {
[226](#226)            n.visit_mut_children_with(self);
[227](#227)        } else if !n.is_empty() {
[228](#228)            n.take();
[229](#229)        }
[230](#230)    }
[231](#231)
[232](#232)    fn visit_mut_ts_import_equals_decl(&mut self, _: &mut TsImportEqualsDecl) {
[233](#233)        }
[235](#235)
[236](#236)    fn visit_mut_ts_param_prop(&mut self, n: &mut TsParamProp) {
[237](#237)        n.decorators.visit_mut_with(self);
[239](#239)        n.param.visit_mut_with(self);
[240](#240)    }
[241](#241)}
[242](#242)
[243](#243)fn should_retain_module_item(module_item: &ModuleItem, in_namespace: bool) -> bool {
[244](#244)    match module_item {
[245](#245)        ModuleItem::ModuleDecl(ModuleDecl::ExportDecl(export_decl)) => {
[246](#246)            if in_namespace && export_decl.decl.is_var() {
[250](#250)                return true;
[251](#251)            }
[252](#252)
[253](#253)            should_retain_decl(&export_decl.decl)
[254](#254)        }
[255](#255)        ModuleItem::Stmt(stmt) => should_retain_stmt(stmt),
[256](#256)        _ => module_item.is_concrete(),
[257](#257)    }
[258](#258)}
[259](#259)
[260](#260)fn should_retain_stmt(stmt: &Stmt) -> bool {
[261](#261)    match stmt {
[262](#262)        Stmt::Decl(decl) => should_retain_decl(decl),
[263](#263)        _ => stmt.is_concrete(),
[264](#264)    }
[265](#265)}
[266](#266)
[267](#267)fn should_retain_decl(decl: &Decl) -> bool {
[268](#268)    if decl.is_declare() {
[269](#269)        return false;
[270](#270)    }
[271](#271)
[272](#272)    decl.is_concrete()
[273](#273)}
[274](#274)
[275](#275)pub(crate) trait IsConcrete {
[276](#276)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool;
[277](#277)}
[278](#278)
[279](#279)impl IsConcrete for TsModuleDecl {
[280](#280)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool {
[281](#281)        self.body
[282](#282)            .as_ref()
[283](#283)            .map(|body| body.is_concrete())
[284](#284)            .unwrap_or_default()
[285](#285)    }
[286](#286)}
[287](#287)
[288](#288)impl IsConcrete for TsNamespaceBody {
[289](#289)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool {
[290](#290)        match self {
[291](#291)            Self::TsModuleBlock(ts_module_block) => {
[292](#292)                ts_module_block.body.iter().any(|item| item.is_concrete())
[293](#293)            }
[294](#294)            Self::TsNamespaceDecl(ts_namespace_decl) => ts_namespace_decl.body.is_concrete(),
[295](#295)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[296](#296)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[297](#297)        }
[298](#298)    }
[299](#299)}
[300](#300)
[301](#301)impl IsConcrete for ModuleItem {
[302](#302)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool {
[303](#303)        match self {
[304](#304)            Self::ModuleDecl(module_decl) => module_decl.is_concrete(),
[305](#305)            Self::Stmt(stmt) => stmt.is_concrete(),
[306](#306)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[307](#307)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[308](#308)        }
[309](#309)    }
[310](#310)}
[311](#311)
[312](#312)impl IsConcrete for ModuleDecl {
[313](#313)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool {
[314](#314)        match self {
[315](#315)            Self::Import(import_decl) => !import_decl.type_only,
[316](#316)            Self::ExportDecl(export_decl) => export_decl.decl.is_concrete(),
[317](#317)            Self::ExportNamed(named_export) => !named_export.type_only,
[318](#318)            Self::ExportDefaultDecl(export_default_decl) => export_default_decl.decl.is_concrete(),
[319](#319)            Self::ExportDefaultExpr(..) => true,
[320](#320)            Self::ExportAll(export_all) => !export_all.type_only,
[321](#321)            Self::TsImportEquals(ts_import_equals) => !ts_import_equals.is_type_only,
[322](#322)            Self::TsExportAssignment(..) => true,
[323](#323)            Self::TsNamespaceExport(..) => false,
[324](#324)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[325](#325)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[326](#326)        }
[327](#327)    }
[328](#328)}
[329](#329)
[330](#330)impl IsConcrete for Decl {
[331](#331)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool {
[332](#332)        match self {
[333](#333)            Self::TsInterface(..) | Self::TsTypeAlias(..) => false,
[334](#334)            Self::Fn(r#fn) => r#fn.function.body.is_some(),
[335](#335)            Self::Class(..) | Self::Var(..) | Self::Using(..) | Self::TsEnum(..) => true,
[336](#336)            Self::TsModule(ts_module) => ts_module.is_concrete(),
[337](#337)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[338](#338)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[339](#339)        }
[340](#340)    }
[341](#341)}
[342](#342)
[343](#343)impl IsConcrete for DefaultDecl {
[344](#344)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool {
[345](#345)        match self {
[346](#346)            Self::Class(_) => true,
[347](#347)            Self::Fn(r#fn) => r#fn.function.body.is_some(),
[348](#348)            Self::TsInterfaceDecl(..) => false,
[349](#349)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[350](#350)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[351](#351)        }
[352](#352)    }
[353](#353)}
[354](#354)
[355](#355)impl IsConcrete for Stmt {
[356](#356)    fn is_concrete(&self) -> bool {
[357](#357)        match self {
[358](#358)            Self::Empty(..) => false,
[359](#359)            Self::Decl(decl) => decl.is_concrete(),
[360](#360)            _ => true,
[361](#361)        }
[362](#362)    }
[363](#363)}
[364](#364)
[365](#365)trait IsDeclare {
[366](#366)    fn is_declare(&self) -> bool;
[367](#367)}
[368](#368)
[369](#369)impl IsDeclare for Decl {
[370](#370)    fn is_declare(&self) -> bool {
[371](#371)        match self {
[372](#372)            Decl::Class(class) => class.declare,
[373](#373)            Decl::Fn(r#fn) => r#fn.declare,
[374](#374)            Decl::Var(var) => var.declare,
[375](#375)            Decl::Using(_) => false,
[376](#376)            Decl::TsInterface(_) | Decl::TsTypeAlias(_) => true,
[378](#378)            Decl::TsEnum(ts_enum) => ts_enum.declare,
[379](#379)            Decl::TsModule(ts_module) => ts_module.declare || ts_module.global,
[380](#380)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[381](#381)            _ => panic!("unable to access unknown nodes"),
[382](#382)        }
[383](#383)    }
[384](#384)}

[51](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#51)pub enum TsImportExportAssignConfig {
[52](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#52)    ///  - Rewrite `import foo = require("foo")` to `var foo = require("foo")`
[53](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#53)    ///  - Rewrite `export =` to `module.exports = `
[54](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#54)    ///
[55](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#55)    /// Note: This option is deprecated as all CJS/AMD/UMD can handle it
[56](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#56)    /// themselves.
[57](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#57)    #[default]
[58](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#58)    Classic,
[59](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#59)
[60](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#60)    /// preserve for CJS/AMD/UMD
[61](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#61)    Preserve,
[62](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#62)
[63](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#63)    /// Rewrite `import foo = require("foo")` to
[64](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#64)    /// ```javascript
[65](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#65)    /// import { createRequire as _createRequire } from "module";
[66](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#66)    /// const __require = _createRequire(import.meta.url);
[67](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#67)    /// const foo = __require("foo");
[68](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#68)    /// ```
[69](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#69)    ///
[70](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#70)    /// Report error for `export =`
[71](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#71)    NodeNext,
[72](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#72)
[73](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#73)    /// Both `import =` and `export =` are disabled.
[74](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#74)    /// An error will be reported if an import/export assignment is found.
[75](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#75)    EsNext,
[76](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#76)}
